run_set_multi_processing_default: run set_multi_processing with default fork method and zero opencv threads
run_set_multi_processing_spawn: run set_multi_processing with spawn method for cross platform compatibility
run_set_multi_processing_distributed: run set_multi_processing in distributed mode to set OMP and MKL threads to 1
run_set_multi_processing_custom_threads: run set_multi_processing with custom opencv thread count for performance tuning
review_set_multi_processing: review set_multi_processing function that configures multiprocessing start method and thread environment variables
